sources.title: The AI Video Model That Hit #1 — With One Big Catch
sources.snippet: Wan 3.0 review 2026: Alibaba's new video model tops Artificial Analysis in two categories with 30-second native-audio generation — and can turn a PDF or webpage into a video. But the "open weights" claim circulating online doesn't hold up: the official GitHub repo has no downloadable weights. Here's the pricing, benchmarks, and the reality check.
